rule.description: Permanently unreachable production code: branches of live functions guarded by conditions that constant-fold to false, and unexported package-level functions, methods, types, or constants with no reference from any executable context (live declarations, package variable initializers, or _test.go files), where references from constant-false-guarded branches and other unreachable declarations do not keep a symbol alive.

backend.exit_contract: 0 = rule matched nothing; 3 = rule matched, one line per match (<file>:<line>: [dead-rollout-residue] ...); 1 = analysis could not complete (fail closed)
backend.algorithm: Collect constant-false guarded regions per production file (skipping platform-target guards), build a fixpoint over executable contexts (exported declarations, init/main, package variable initializers, references from _test.go files), then report unexported declarations that never acquire an executable reference and unreachable branches in live declarations, with per-match evidence of total and unreachable-only reference counts.

checks.description: One liveness rule applied repository-wide: a package-level declaration or branch is reported when no executable context can ever reach it, because live roots and their references form a reachability fixpoint that the site never joins.
checks.detected_relation: unexported declaration / guarded branch -> no executable reach from live roots (exported declarations, init, package var initializers, tests)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Reported declarations cannot execute or be referenced under any program input, so they are dead code that must be removed; the guarded branches are permanently unreachable because their guard conditions are compile-time constants.

excluded.reason: Branches guarded by runtime.GOOS/GOARCH/GOARM/GO386/GOAMD64/GOMIPS/GOMIPS64/MSan/ASan/RaceEnabled comparisons may execute on other build targets and are never reported.

excluded.pattern: empty-body function and method declarations (placeholder/TODO stubs)
excluded.reason: Declarations with an empty body, such as the pre-existing Config.extendURL stub in the pinned tree, are placeholders rather than unreachable executable machinery and are not reported.
Package variable initializers run at package init and may self-register, so unused-looking variables are not reported.
Test-only use still constrains removal in this repository's convention, so test-referenced unexported symbols stay live.
The rule credits only unexported package-level functions, methods, types, and constants; exported symbols are part of the public surface.
